articles.title: Increased Scrutiny Faces the 340B Drug Discount Program
articles.summary: The massive 340B drug discount program is drawing heightened policy and market scrutiny regarding its operations and oversight. This matters to self-funded employers and PBMs because 340B dynamics directly impact commercial drug pricing, manufacturer discounting, and overall health plan cost trends. Key implications include potential legislative or regulatory shifts that could alter how covered entities and pharmacies handle 340B savings.
articles.source_line: Source: Pacific Research Institute; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 20:33:11 GMT

articles.title: Federal Scrutiny Intensifies on the 340B Drug Discount Program
articles.summary: The massive 340B drug discount program is facing heightened regulatory and legislative scrutiny as stakeholders debate its scope and impact on drug pricing. For self-funded employers and PBMs, changes to 340B directly influence overall commercial drug pricing trends, hospital contracting, and specialty drug cost dynamics.

articles.title: Opioid MDL Judge Denies PBM Affiliates Motion To Dismiss
articles.summary: A federal judge denied a motion to dismiss filed by pharmacy benefit manager affiliates in ongoing opioid multidistrict litigation. This ruling keeps PBM entities exposed to liability related to the opioid crisis, signaling potential legal and financial risks for major industry players. Self-funded employers should monitor how these legal developments could impact PBM operational stability and future pricing models.

articles.title: PBM Network Terminations Present Operational and Compliance Risks for Pharmacy Networks
articles.summary: Pharmacy network terminations by PBMs create significant downstream operational and compliance challenges that extend far beyond simply losing a contract. For self-funded employers and PBM administrators, understanding these network dynamics is critical for maintaining adequate member access and avoiding regulatory scrutiny.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:24:01 GMT

articles.title: Ustekinumab Biosimilar Efficacy in Crohn Disease Supports Plan Formularies
articles.summary: Real-world evidence confirming the efficacy of ustekinumab biosimilars in treating Crohn disease reinforces confidence for self-funded employers transitioning patients from reference biologics. This clinical validation supports PBM formulary strategies aimed at driving biosimilar uptake to lower specialty drug spend.
articles.source_line: Source: Center for Biosimilars; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:04:07 GMT

articles.title: FDA Flags Quality Concerns at Chinese Facilities Supplying GLP-1 Compounding Ingredients
articles.summary: Federal investigators found severe contamination issues, including black mold and insects, at Chinese manufacturing plants producing active pharmaceutical ingredients for compounded GLP-1 drugs. This safety risk underscores the dangers of unapproved compounded weight-loss medications, providing self-funded employers with strong justification to steer members toward brand-name coverage policies. The news highlights critical clinical and financial risks associated with the booming compounding market.
articles.source_line: Source: Los Angeles Times; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 20:22:53 GMT

articles.title: Big Pharma Intervenes to Defend 340B Rebate Pilot in AHA Lawsuit
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical manufacturers, including AbbVie, are seeking to join the defense of restrictive 340B contract pharmacy rebate models in a legal challenge brought by the American Hospital Association. The ongoing litigation impacts how drug discounts flow through the supply chain, carrying broader implications for drug pricing transparency and the financial stability of safety-net providers. Self-funded employers and PBMs monitor these 340B dynamics closely as they influence overall commercial drug spend and market pricing pressure.
articles.source_line: Source: Crain's Chicago Business; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:15:00 GMT

articles.title: Preparing for the Shift to 340B Rebate Models in Pharmacy Benefits
articles.summary: Industry experts discuss strategic preparations for transitioning to a 340B rebate model as drug pricing dynamics evolve. This shift significantly impacts drug acquisition costs, contract pharmacy arrangements, and overall pharmacy benefit management strategies. Self-funded employers must monitor these policy and operational changes to understand their implications on specialty drug spend and network pricing.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:25:59 GMT

articles.title: Arkansas Pharmacies Escalate Legal Battle Against PBMs With $500M Lawsuit
articles.summary: Independent pharmacies in Arkansas have launched a massive $500 million lawsuit against major pharmacy benefit managers, escalating ongoing state-level conflicts over reimbursement rates and business practices. This litigation underscores the mounting legal and regulatory pressures facing the PBM industry, which could ultimately influence plan design and cost management strategies for self-funded employers operating in the region.
articles.source_line: Source: Arkansas Business; Mon, 19 Oct 2026 05:00:53 GMT
